167     text = text.replace(/<family\/driver>/g, pair);

169   return {
170     ok: false,
171     error: extra.error ?? String(code).toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, '-'),

174     status_code: code,
175     text,

252 /**

267 /**
268  * G4 + SC6 precondition. FAIL closed when either is not ready.
269  *
270  * @param {{ root?: string, fallback?: object|null, sc6?: object|null }} [opts]
271  * @returns {{ ok: true, g4: object, sc6: object }
272  *   | { ok: false, halt: string, code: string, message: string, g4?: object|null, sc6?: object|null }}
273  */
274 export function assertCommissionPreconditions(opts = {}) {
275   const root = opts.root ?? DEFAULT_ROOT;
276   const g4 = assertG4Precondition({ root, fallback: opts.fallback ?? null });
277   if (!g4.ok) {
278     return {
279       ok: false,
280       halt: g4.halt ?? G4_HALT_NAME,
281       code: COMMISSION_CODE.PRECONDITION_HALT,
282       status_code: COMMISSION_CODE.PRECONDITION_HALT,
283       text: COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.PRECONDITION_HALT],
284       message: g4.message ?? COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.PRECONDITION_HALT],
285       g4: g4.verdict ?? readG4Verdict(root),
286       sc6: null,
287       launched: false,
288     };
289   }
290 
291   const sc6 = opts.sc6 ?? readSc6Feasibility(root);
292   if (!sc6 || sc6.verdict !== 'FEASIBLE') {
293     const evaluated =
294       sc6 && typeof sc6.commissionable_count === 'number'
295         ? evaluateSc6Feasibility(sc6.commissionable_count)
296         : evaluateSc6Feasibility(0);
297     return {
298       ok: false,
299       halt: SC6_HALT_NAME,
300       code: COMMISSION_CODE.PRECONDITION_HALT,
301       status_code: COMMISSION_CODE.PRECONDITION_HALT,
302       text: COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.PRECONDITION_HALT],
303       message:
304         evaluated.reason ||
305         'sc6-feasibility.json not FEASIBLE — commissioning is blocked, not degraded.',
306       g4: g4.verdict,
307       sc6: sc6 ?? evaluated,
308       launched: false,
309     };
310   }
311 
312   return { ok: true, g4: g4.verdict, sc6 };
313 }

349 /**
350  * Resolve a skill against the commissionable table.
351  * @param {string} skillName
352  * @param {object} table

354  *   | { ok: false, code: string, skill: string, excluded_reason: string|null, message: string }}
355  */
356 export function selectCommissionableSkill(skillName, table) {
357   const skill = normalizeCommissionSkill(skillName);
358   if (!skill) {
359     return {
360       ok: false,
361       code: COMMISSION_CODE.SKILL_REFUSED,
362       skill: skillName == null ? '' : String(skillName),
363       excluded_reason: 'unknown_skill',
364       message: `${skillName ?? '(empty)'} is not commissionable (unknown_skill) — choose from the proven set.`,
365     };
366   }
367   const rows = Array.isArray(table?.rows) ? table.rows : [];
368   const row = rows.find((r) => r && r.skill === skill) ?? null;
369   if (!row) {
370     return {
371       ok: false,
372       code: COMMISSION_CODE.SKILL_REFUSED,
373       skill,
374       excluded_reason: 'not_in_table',
375       message: `${skill} is not commissionable (not_in_table) — choose from the proven set.`,
376     };
377   }
378   if (row.commissionable !== true) {
379     const reason = row.excluded_reason ?? 'not_commissionable';
380     return {
381       ok: false,
382       code: COMMISSION_CODE.SKILL_REFUSED,
383       skill,
384       excluded_reason: reason,
385       row,
386       message: `${skill} is not commissionable (${reason}) — choose from the proven set.`,
387     };
388   }
389   return { ok: true, skill, row };
390 }

394 /**
395  * Every `default_cli` value Anchor can emit (families + subscription drivers
396  * + the bare `grok` HTTP driver name that must be refused).
397  */
398 export const ANCHOR_DEFAULT_CLI_VALUES = Object.freeze([
399   'chatgpt',
400   'chatgpt-cli',
401   'claude',
402   'gemini',
403   'gemini-cli',
404   'agy',
405   'grok',
406   'grok-cli',
407 ]);
408 
409 /**
410  * Map a single default_cli value through the seats law.
411  * Family names resolve via familyToSubscriptionDriver; driver names must be
412  * subscription CLIs. Bare `grok` DRIVER is refused (family `grok` → grok-cli).
413  *
414  * @param {string} defaultCli
415  * @returns {{ ok: true, default_cli: string, family: string|null, driver: string, subscription: true }
416  *   | { ok: false, default_cli: string, code: string, error: string, message: string }}
417  */
418 export function mapDefaultCliToSeat(defaultCli) {
419   const raw = String(defaultCli ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
420   if (!raw) {
421     return {
422       ok: false,
423       default_cli: raw,
424       code: COMMISSION_CODE.SEAT_REFUSED,
425       error: 'seat-not-subscription',
426       message: COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.SEAT_REFUSED],
427     };
428   }
429 
430   // Bare grok DRIVER name is forbidden (raw xAI HTTP). Family grok maps below.
431   if (raw === 'grok') {
432     return {
433       ok: false,
434       default_cli: raw,
435       code: COMMISSION_CODE.SEAT_REFUSED,
436       error: 'bare-grok-driver-refused',
437       message:
438         'Seat does not resolve to a subscription CLI — refused by the seats law. (bare grok driver; use family grok → grok-cli)',
439       bare_grok_driver: true,
440     };
441   }
442 
443   // Already a subscription driver
444   if (PRODUCTION_SEAT_DRIVERS.includes(raw) || SUBSCRIPTION_DRIVERS.includes(raw)) {
445     const family =
446       raw === 'chatgpt-cli'
447         ? 'chatgpt'
448         : raw === 'claude'
449           ? 'claude'
450           : raw === 'grok-cli'
451             ? 'grok'
452             : raw === 'gemini-cli' || raw === 'agy'
453               ? 'gemini'
454               : null;
455     return {
456       ok: true,
457       default_cli: raw,
458       family,
459       driver: raw,
460       subscription: true,
461     };
462   }
463 
464   // Family name → subscription driver
465   const family = normalizeFamily(raw);
466   if (family) {
467     const driver = familyToSubscriptionDriver(family);
468     if (driver && PRODUCTION_SEAT_DRIVERS.includes(driver)) {
469       return {
470         ok: true,
471         default_cli: raw,
472         family,
473         driver,
474         subscription: true,
475         mapped_from_family: true,
476       };
477     }
478   }
479 
480   return {
481     ok: false,
482     default_cli: raw,
483     code: COMMISSION_CODE.SEAT_REFUSED,
484     error: 'seat-not-subscription',
485     message: COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.SEAT_REFUSED],
486   };
487 }
488 
489 /**
490  * Mapping assertion: walk EVERY default_cli Anchor can emit.
491  * Each resolves through resolveSeats (via family prefs) to a subscription CLI
492  * seat, or is refused by name. Bare grok driver refused; family grok → grok-cli.
493  *
494  * @param {{ resolveSeatsFn?: Function }} [opts]
495  * @returns {{ ok: boolean, results: object[], failures: object[] }}
496  */
497 export function assertDefaultCliMapping(opts = {}) {
498   const resolve = opts.resolveSeatsFn ?? resolveSeats;
499   const results = [];
500   const failures = [];
501 
502   for (const value of ANCHOR_DEFAULT_CLI_VALUES) {
503     const mapped = mapDefaultCliToSeat(value);
504     if (value === 'grok') {
505       // Bare driver must refuse
506       if (mapped.ok !== false || mapped.error !== 'bare-grok-driver-refused') {
507         const fail = {
508           default_cli: value,
509           expected: 'bare-grok-driver-refused',
510           got: mapped,
511         };
512         failures.push(fail);
513         results.push({ default_cli: value, ok: false, ...fail });
514         continue;
515       }
516       results.push({ default_cli: value, ok: true, refused: true, mapped });
517       continue;
518     }
519 
520     // For family/driver values, resolve seats with coding_family derived from the value
521     const familyHint =
522       mapped.family ??
523       (value === 'chatgpt' || value === 'chatgpt-cli'
524         ? 'chatgpt'
525         : value === 'claude'
526           ? 'claude'
527           : value === 'gemini' || value === 'gemini-cli' || value === 'agy'
528             ? 'gemini'
529             : value === 'grok-cli'
530               ? 'grok'
531               : null);
532 
533     if (!mapped.ok || !familyHint) {
534       failures.push({ default_cli: value, mapped });
535       results.push({ default_cli: value, ok: false, mapped });
536       continue;
537     }
538 
539     const seats = resolve({
540       prefs: {
541         coding_family: familyHint,
542         review_family: familyHint === 'claude' ? 'gemini' : 'claude',
543         default_cli: value,
544       },
545     });
546 
547     if (!seats.ok || !isProductionSeatSafe(seats)) {
548       failures.push({ default_cli: value, seats, mapped });
549       results.push({ default_cli: value, ok: false, seats, mapped });
550       continue;
551     }
552 
553     // Family grok must land on grok-cli
554     if (familyHint === 'grok' && seats.coding_driver !== 'grok-cli') {
555       failures.push({
556         default_cli: value,
557         expected_driver: 'grok-cli',
558         got: seats.coding_driver,
559       });
560       results.push({ default_cli: value, ok: false, seats, mapped });
561       continue;
562     }
563 
564     results.push({
565       default_cli: value,
566       ok: true,
567       family: familyHint,
568       coding_driver: seats.coding_driver,
569       review_driver: seats.review_driver,
570       mapped,
571       seats_ok: true,
572     });
573   }
574 
575   return {
576     ok: failures.length === 0,
577     results,
578     failures,
579     values: [...ANCHOR_DEFAULT_CLI_VALUES],
580   };
581 }

583 // ── Seat-collision predicate (named pure function) ─────────────────────────
584 
585 /**
586  * Pure predicate: does the proposed (family, driver) collide with any live run seat?
587  *
588  * A "live run" is an entry with state in {queued, running} (or live:true) that
589  * holds a seat with matching family AND driver on coding or review.
590  *
591  * @param {{ family?: string|null, driver?: string|null, coding_family?: string|null, coding_driver?: string|null, review_family?: string|null, review_driver?: string|null }} proposedSeat
592  * @param {Array<object>|null|undefined} liveRuns
593  * @returns {{ collision: boolean, family?: string, driver?: string, run?: object|null }}
594  */
595 export function hasSeatCollision(proposedSeat, liveRuns) {
596   const proposed = proposedSeat && typeof proposedSeat === 'object' ? proposedSeat : {};
597   const pairs = [];
598   const add = (family, driver) => {
599     const f = family != null && family !== '' ? String(family) : null;
600     const d = driver != null && driver !== '' ? String(driver) : null;
601     if (f || d) pairs.push({ family: f, driver: d });
602   };
603   add(proposed.family ?? proposed.coding_family, proposed.driver ?? proposed.coding_driver);
604   add(proposed.review_family, proposed.review_driver);
605 
606   const runs = Array.isArray(liveRuns) ? liveRuns : [];
607   for (const run of runs) {
608     if (!run || typeof run !== 'object') continue;
609     const state = run.state ?? run.lifecycle_state ?? null;
610     const live =
611       run.live === true ||
612       state === 'queued' ||
613       state === 'running' ||
614       state === 'live';
615     if (!live) continue;
616 
617     const seat = run.seat ?? run.seats ?? run;
618     const held = [
619       {
620         family: seat.coding_family ?? seat.family ?? null,
621         driver: seat.coding_driver ?? seat.driver ?? null,
622       },
623       {
624         family: seat.review_family ?? null,
625         driver: seat.review_driver ?? null,
626       },
627     ];
628 
629     for (const p of pairs) {
630       for (const h of held) {
631         if (
632           p.family &&
633           h.family &&
634           p.driver &&
635           h.driver &&
636           String(p.family) === String(h.family) &&
637           String(p.driver) === String(h.driver)
638         ) {
639           return {
640             collision: true,
641             family: p.family,
642             driver: p.driver,
643             run,
644           };
645         }
646       }
647     }
648   }
649   return { collision: false, run: null };
650 }
651 
652 // ── Hash / estimate ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
653 
654 function sortKeys(value) {
655   if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(sortKeys);
656   if (value && typeof value === 'object') {
657     const out = {};
658     for (const k of Object.keys(value).sort()) {
659       out[k] = sortKeys(value[k]);
660     }
661     return out;
662   }
663   return value;
664 }
665 
666 /**
667  * Content hash of the rendered proposal (skill + seat + depth + estimate).
668  * @param {object} payload
669  * @returns {string}
670  */
671 export function hashCommissionProposal(payload) {
672   const canonical = JSON.stringify(sortKeys(payload));
673   return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonical).digest('hex');
674 }
675 
676 /**
677  * Hash body for TOCTOU: skill + seat + depth + estimate only.
678  * @param {{ skill: string, seat: object, depth_cell: string|null, estimate: object }} body
679  */
680 export function proposalHashBody(body) {
681   return {
682     skill: body.skill ?? null,
683     seat: {
684       coding_family: body.seat?.coding_family ?? null,
685       review_family: body.seat?.review_family ?? null,
686       coding_driver: body.seat?.coding_driver ?? null,
687       review_driver: body.seat?.review_driver ?? null,
688       default_cli: body.seat?.default_cli ?? null,
689     },
690     depth_cell: body.depth_cell ?? null,
691     estimate: {
692       cost_usd: body.estimate?.cost_usd ?? null,
693       tokens: body.estimate?.tokens ?? null,
694       rate_key: body.estimate?.rate_key ?? null,
695     },
696   };
697 }

699 /**
700  * Deterministic spend estimate for a commission (tokens × rate table).
701  * @param {{ skill: string, depth_cell?: string|null, step_name?: string|null }} opts
702  */
703 export function estimateCommissionSpend(opts = {}) {
704   const depth = String(opts.depth_cell ?? 'LITE').toUpperCase();
705   const baseTokens =
706     DEPTH_TOKEN_BUDGET[depth] ?? DEPTH_TOKEN_BUDGET.LITE;
707   const label = `${opts.skill ?? 'skill'} ${opts.step_name ?? ''} ${depth}`;
708   const labelTokens = estimateTokens(label);
709   const tokens = baseTokens + labelTokens;
710   const priced = priceTokens(tokens, { rate_key: 'coding' });
711   return {
712     ...priced,
713     depth_cell: depth,
714     synthetic: true,
715     disclaimer: COST_MODEL_DISCLAIMER,
716     shown_before_confirm: true,
717   };
718 }

720 // ── Propose (bound to named step) ──────────────────────────────────────────
721 
722 function nonEmpty(v) {
723   return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '';
724 }
725 
726 function todayIso() {
727   return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
728 }
729 
730 /**
731  * Propose a commission FOR a named roadmap step (ULID / step id).
732  * Renders skill + seat + depth + estimated spend BEFORE confirmation.
733  * Nothing is written; nothing runs.
734  *
735  * @param {{
736  *   roadmap: object|string,
737  *   step_id?: string|null,
738  *   step?: string|null,
739  *   skill?: string|null,
740  *   step_type?: string|null,
741  *   depth_cell?: string|null,
742  *   depth?: string|null,
743  *   who?: string|null,
744  *   seats?: object|null,
745  *   prefs?: object|null,
746  *   env?: object,
747  *   prefsPath?: string|null,
748  *   skills_table?: object|null,
749  *   root?: string,
750  *   live_runs?: object[],
751  *   project_cwd?: string|null,
752  *   commission_id?: string|null,
753  *   at?: string,
754  *   skip_precondition?: boolean,
755  *   precondition_fallback?: object|null,
756  * }} opts
757  */
758 export function proposeBoundCommission(opts = {}) {
759   if (opts.skip_precondition !== true) {
760     const pre = assertCommissionPreconditions({
761       root: opts.root ?? DEFAULT_ROOT,
762       fallback: opts.precondition_fallback ?? null,
763     });
764     if (!pre.ok) {
765       return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.PRECONDITION_HALT, {
766         error: 'precondition-halt',
767         halt: pre.halt,
768         g4: pre.g4,
769         sc6: pre.sc6,
770         message: pre.message,
771       });
772     }
773   }
774 
775   const step_id = opts.step_id ?? opts.step ?? null;
776   if (!nonEmpty(step_id)) {
777     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STEP_UNBOUND, {
778       error: 'step-not-found',
779       state: 'free-floating',
780     });
781   }
782 
783   const validated = validateRoadmap(opts.roadmap ?? null);
784   if (!validated.ok) {
785     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STORE_UNREADABLE, {
786       error: validated.error ?? 'roadmap-unreadable',
787       message: validated.message ?? COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.STORE_UNREADABLE],
788       detail: validated,
789     });
790   }
791   const step = validated.projection.find((s) => s.id === step_id) ?? null;
792   if (!step) {
793     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STEP_UNBOUND, {
794       error: 'step-not-found',
795       step_id,
796     });
797   }
798 
799   // Dispatch by locked step-type map when skill omitted or step_type given.
800   let skillInput = opts.skill ?? null;
801   let step_type = opts.step_type ?? step.step_type ?? step.type ?? null;
802   if (!skillInput && step_type) {
803     const mapped = skillForStepType(step_type);
804     if (mapped.ok) skillInput = mapped.skill;
805   }
806   // BUILD default when name/status hints (GWT: BUILD step → Foreman)
807   if (!skillInput && step_type) {
808     const upper = String(step_type).toUpperCase();
809     if (STEP_TYPE_SKILL_MAP[upper]) {
810       skillInput = STEP_TYPE_SKILL_MAP[upper].skill;
811     }
812   }
813 
814   const tableLoad = loadSkillsTable({
815     root: opts.root,
816     skills_table: opts.skills_table,
817   });
818   if (!tableLoad.ok) {
819     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STORE_UNREADABLE, {
820       error: 'skills-table-unreadable',
821       message: tableLoad.message,
822     });
823   }
824 
825   const selected = selectCommissionableSkill(skillInput, tableLoad.table);
826   if (!selected.ok) {
827     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.SKILL_REFUSED, {
828       error: 'skill-not-commissionable',
829       skill: selected.skill,
830       excluded_reason: selected.excluded_reason,
831       message: selected.message,
832     });
833   }
834   const skill = selected.skill;
835 
836   // Seats law: resolveSeats → subscription CLIs only
837   // Forward exists/readFile so host-less callers (T-HOST-0) can force defaults
838   // without silently reading the machine ~/.anchor store.
839   const seats =
840     opts.seats && typeof opts.seats === 'object'
841       ? opts.seats
842       : resolveSeats({
843           prefs: opts.prefs ?? null,
844           env: opts.env,
845           prefsPath: opts.prefsPath,
846           exists: opts.exists,
847           readFile: opts.readFile,
848         });
849 
850   if (!seats || seats.ok === false || !isProductionSeatSafe(seats)) {
851     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.SEAT_REFUSED, {
852       error: 'seat-not-subscription',
853       seats,
854     });
855   }
856 
857   // Seat-collision pure predicate
858   const collision = hasSeatCollision(
859     {
860       coding_family: seats.coding_family,
861       coding_driver: seats.coding_driver,
862       review_family: seats.review_family,
863       review_driver: seats.review_driver,
864     },
865     opts.live_runs,
866   );
867   if (collision.collision) {
868     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.SEAT_COLLISION, {
869       error: 'seat-collision',
870       family: collision.family,
871       driver: collision.driver,
872       live_run: collision.run,
873     });
874   }
875 
876   const depth_cell = opts.depth_cell ?? opts.depth ?? 'LITE';
877   const estimate = estimateCommissionSpend({
878     skill,
879     depth_cell,
880     step_name: step.name,
881   });
882 
883   const seatStamp = {
884     coding_family: seats.coding_family,
885     review_family: seats.review_family,
886     default_cli: seats.default_cli ?? null,
887     coding_driver: seats.coding_driver,
888     review_driver: seats.review_driver,
889     cross_model: seats.cross_model,
890     source: seats.prefs_source ?? seats.source ?? 'prefs_or_defaults',
891     subscription_only: true,
892   };
893 
894   const commission = buildCommission({
895     skill,
896     depth_cell,
897     active_effort: step.name,
898     project_cwd: opts.project_cwd ?? null,
899     seats,
900     prefs: opts.prefs ?? null,
901     env: opts.env,
902     prefsPath: opts.prefsPath,
903     commission_id: opts.commission_id ?? null,
904   });
905   if (!commission.ok) {
906     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.SEAT_REFUSED, {
907       error: commission.error ?? 'commission-build-failed',
908       message: commission.message,
909       commission,
910     });
911   }
912 
913   const hashBody = proposalHashBody({
914     skill,
915     seat: seatStamp,
916     depth_cell,
917     estimate,
918   });
919   const proposal_hash = hashCommissionProposal(hashBody);
920   const at = opts.at ?? todayIso();
921 
922   const proposal = {
923     ok: true,
924     spelling: SPELLING,
925     schema: COMMISSION_PROPOSAL_SCHEMA,
926     kind: 'commission_proposal',
927     proposal_id: `ecgberht-proposal-${step_id}-${proposal_hash.slice(0, 12)}`,
928     proposal_hash,
929     step_id,
930     step,
931     step_type: step_type ?? null,
932     skill,
933     depth_cell,
934     seat: seatStamp,
935     seats: seatStamp,
936     estimate,
937     rendering: {
938       skill,
939       seat: seatStamp.coding_driver ?? seatStamp.coding_family,
940       depth: depth_cell,
941       estimate_usd: estimate.cost_usd,
942       estimate_tokens: estimate.tokens,
943       summary: `Commission ${skill} at depth ${depth_cell} on seat ${seatStamp.coding_driver} (~$${estimate.cost_usd} synthetic) for step ${step_id}.`,
944       disclaimer: COST_MODEL_DISCLAIMER,
945     },
946     proposed_by: opts.who ?? 'ecgberht-steward',
947     at,
948     commission,
949     job_runner: ANCHOR_JOB_COMPOSE,
950     requires_confirm: true,
951     confirmed: false,
952     run_started: false,
953     primary_ux: COMMISSION_PRIMARY_UX,
954     mode_picker_primary: false,
955     single_writer: ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER,
956     table_bound: true,
957     seats_law: true,
958     message: `Steward proposes commissioning ${skill} for step '${step_id}' (seat ${seatStamp.coding_driver}, depth ${depth_cell}, estimate $${estimate.cost_usd} synthetic). Confirm or refuse — nothing runs until confirm.`,
959   };
960 
961   // T-ATT-CS1: commission proposed / awaiting confirm → publish at the propose verb.
962   let attention_publish = null;
963   const projectPath = opts.project_cwd ?? opts.project_path ?? opts.projectPath ?? null;
964   if (projectPath && opts.skip_attention_publish !== true) {
965     attention_publish = publishAttention(projectPath, {
966       // T-ATT-CS1
967       call_site: ATTENTION_CALL_SITES.PROPOSE,
968       who: opts.who ?? 'ecgberht-steward',
969       at,
970       seed: opts.roadmap ?? opts.seed,
971       skip_index: true,
972       ledgerView: {
973         events: opts.roadmap?.roadmap_events ?? [],
974         projection: validated.projection ?? [],
975         awaiting_confirm: true,
976         commission_proposal: proposal,
977         at,
978       },
979       home: opts.home,
980       env: opts.env,
981       project_id: opts.project_id,
982       skip_brief_cache: opts.skip_brief_cache === true,
983     });
984   }
985 
986   return {
987     ...proposal,
988     attention_publish,
989   };
990 }
991 
992 // ── Executor seam (host-injected) ──────────────────────────────────────────
993 
994 /** @type {((dossier: object, ctx: object) => object|Promise<object>)|null} */
995 let _injectedExecutor = null;
996 
997 /** Wave-20 in-session executor availability (set by host / Wave 20 module). */
998 let _insessionExecutor = null;
999 let _insessionAvailable = false;
1000 
1001 /**
1002  * Inject the host executor (Anchor Wave-4 is reference implementation #1).
1003  * Pass null to clear.
1004  * @param {((dossier: object, ctx: object) => object|Promise<object>)|null} fn
1005  */
1006 export function setCommissionExecutor(fn) {
1007   _injectedExecutor = typeof fn === 'function' ? fn : null;
1008 }
1009 
1010 /** @returns {Function|null} */
1011 export function getCommissionExecutor() {
1012   return _injectedExecutor;
1013 }
1014 
1015 /**
1016  * Register / clear the in-session executor (Wave 20 implementation #2).
1017  * @param {((dossier: object, ctx: object) => object|Promise<object>)|null} fn
1018  * @param {{ available?: boolean }} [opts]
1019  */
1020 export function setInSessionExecutor(fn, opts = {}) {
1021   _insessionExecutor = typeof fn === 'function' ? fn : null;
1022   _insessionAvailable =
1023     opts.available !== undefined
1024       ? opts.available === true
1025       : typeof fn === 'function';
1026 }
1027 
1028 /** @returns {{ available: boolean, fn: Function|null }} */
1029 export function getInSessionExecutor() {
1030   return {
1031     available: _insessionAvailable && typeof _insessionExecutor === 'function',
1032     fn: _insessionExecutor,
1033   };
1034 }
1035 
1036 /** Reset both executor hooks (tests). */
1037 export function resetCommissionExecutors() {
1038   _injectedExecutor = null;
1039   _insessionExecutor = null;
1040   _insessionAvailable = false;
1041 }
1042 
1043 /**
1044  * THE ONLY way a confirmed commission reaches an executor.
1045  *
1046  * Resolution order:
1047  *   1. Host-injected executor (Anchor Wave-4)
1048  *   2. In-session executor when available (Wave 20)
1049  *   3. Named no-executor-host — confirmed-and-unlaunched, never silent queue
1050  *
1051  * @param {object} dossier  confirmed commission dossier / job payload
1052  * @param {object} [ctx]
1053  * @returns {object}
1054  */
1055 export function executeCommission(dossier, ctx = {}) {
1056   if (!dossier || typeof dossier !== 'object') {
1057     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
1058       error: 'dossier-required',
1059       message: 'executeCommission requires a confirmed commission dossier.',
1060     });
1061   }
1062 
1063   const confirmed =
1064     dossier.confirmed === true ||
1065     dossier.confirmation != null ||
1066     dossier.state === 'queued' ||
1067     dossier.state === 'confirmed' ||
1068     ctx.confirmed === true;
1069 
1070   if (!confirmed) {
1071     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.UNCONFIRMED, {
1072       error: 'unconfirmed-refused',
1073     });
1074   }
1075 
1076   // Launch seam auth (NS criterion 9): authorize('launch', ctx) before any spawn.
1077   // Zero pid / zero process start on refusal (Wave 19 auth outcome sweep).
1078   const launchAuthCtx =
1079     ctx.authCtx ??
1080     ctx.auth ??
1081     (ctx.token != null || ctx.revoked != null || ctx.principal != null
1082       ? {
1083           token: ctx.token,
1084           principal: ctx.principal,
1085           revoked: ctx.revoked,
1086           expires_at: ctx.expires_at,
1087         }
1088       : null);
1089   if (launchAuthCtx != null) {
1090     const launchDecision = authorize('launch', launchAuthCtx);
1091     if (!launchDecision.ok) {
1092       return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.EXEC_AUTH_REFUSED, {
1093         error: launchDecision.code ?? 'auth-refused',
1094         message:
1095           launchDecision.message ??
1096           COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.EXEC_AUTH_REFUSED],
1097         auth: launchDecision,
1098         launched: false,
1099         processes_launched: 0,
1100         pid: null,
1101         proc_create_time: null,
1102       });
1103     }
1104   }
1105 
1106   // 1. Host-injected
1107   if (typeof _injectedExecutor === 'function') {
1108     try {
1109       const result = _injectedExecutor(dossier, ctx);
1110       return normalizeExecutorResult(result, { path: 'injected' });
1111     } catch (err) {
1112       return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
1113         error: 'executor-threw',
1114         message: String(err?.message ?? err),
1115         path: 'injected',
1116       });
1117     }
1118   }
1119 
1120   // 2. In-session (Wave 20)
1121   if (_insessionAvailable && typeof _insessionExecutor === 'function') {
1122     try {
1123       const result = _insessionExecutor(dossier, ctx);
1124       return normalizeExecutorResult(result, { path: 'insession' });
1125     } catch (err) {
1126       return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
1127         error: 'executor-threw',
1128         message: String(err?.message ?? err),
1129         path: 'insession',
1130       });
1131     }
1132   }
1133 
1134   // 3. Named refusal — never silent queue
1135   return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.NO_EXECUTOR_HOST, {
1136     error: 'no-executor-host',
1137     confirmed: true,
1138     launched: false,
1139     confirmed_and_unlaunched: true,
1140     silently_queued: false,
1141     job_id: dossier.job_id ?? null,
1142     commissioned_as: dossier.commissioned_as ?? null,
1143   });
1144 }
1145 
1146 function normalizeExecutorResult(result, meta = {}) {
1147   if (result && typeof result.then === 'function') {
1148     // Sync surface: executors used in tests are sync. Async callers await themselves.
1149     return {
1150       ok: true,
1151       async: true,
1152       promise: result,
1153       ...meta,
1154     };
1155   }
1156   if (!result || typeof result !== 'object') {
1157     return {
1158       ok: true,
1159       launched: true,
1160       result,
1161       ...meta,
1162     };
1163   }
1164   return {
1165     ok: result.ok !== false,
1166     launched: result.launched !== false && result.ok !== false,
1167     ...meta,
1168     ...result,
1169   };
1170 }
1171 
1172 // ── Confirm (hash-bound, auth, idempotent, executor seam) ──────────────────
1173 
1174 /** In-memory idempotence map for pure (no project_path) confirms. */
1175 const _idempotenceCache = new Map();
1176 
1177 /** Clear T-IDEM-11 memory (tests). */
1178 export function clearCommissionIdempotenceCache() {
1179   _idempotenceCache.clear();
1180 }
1181 
1182 /**
1183  * Confirm a bound commission proposal.
1184  *
1185  * - authorize('confirm', authCtx) via injected hook (never token in engine)
1186  * - proposal_hash must match recomputed content hash
1187  * - mints job_id / commissioned_as; appends commission_bind (spine / journal)
1188  * - T-IDEM-11 on client_event_id
1189  * - hands off via executeCommission; no executor → no-executor-host by name
1190  *
1191  * @param {{
1192  *   proposal: object,
1193  *   proposal_hash?: string,
1194  *   who: string|object,
1195  *   roadmap?: object|null,
1196  *   strip?: object|null,
1197  *   authCtx?: object|null,
1198  *   client_event_id?: string|null,
1199  *   job_id?: string|null,
1200  *   project_path?: string|null,
1201  *   project_id?: string|null,
1202  *   home?: string,
1203  *   at?: string,
1204  *   skip_executor?: boolean,
1205  *   executor_ctx?: object,
1206  * }} opts
1207  */
1208 export function confirmBoundCommission(opts = {}) {
1209   const proposal = opts.proposal;
1210   if (
1211     !proposal ||
1212     typeof proposal !== 'object' ||
1213     proposal.kind !== 'commission_proposal' ||
1214     proposal.requires_confirm !== true
1215   ) {
1216     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
1217       error: 'commission_confirm_requires_proposal',
1218       message:
1219         'Confirm needs a steward commission_proposal (propose/confirm path — not a mode picker).',
1220     });
1221   }
1222 
1223   const who = normalizeWho(opts.who);
1224   if (!who) {
1225     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
1226       error: 'commission_confirm_requires_who',
1227       message: 'Commission confirm is a human decision — pass who confirmed.',
1228       required: ['who'],
1229     });
1230   }
1231 
1232   // Auth via injected authorizer — never a token check inside the engine
1233   const authCtx = opts.authCtx ?? { principal: who.claimed };
1234   const decision = authorize('confirm', authCtx);
1235   if (!decision.ok) {
1236     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.AUTH_REFUSED, {
1237       error: decision.code ?? 'auth-refused',
1238       message: decision.message ?? COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.AUTH_REFUSED],
1239       auth: decision,
1240       bind_appended: false,
1241       processes_launched: 0,
1242     });
1243   }
1244 
1245   // Hash-bound TOCTOU
1246   const expectedHash = recomputeProposalHash(proposal);
1247   const providedHash =
1248     opts.proposal_hash ?? proposal.proposal_hash ?? '';
1249   if (!providedHash || providedHash !== expectedHash) {
1250     return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.CONFIRM_HASH_MISMATCH, {
1251       error: 'confirm-hash-mismatch',
1252       presented_hash: providedHash || null,
1253       expected_hash: expectedHash,
1254       processes_launched: 0,
1255       bind_appended: false,
1256     });
1257   }
1258 
1259   const client_event_id =
1260     opts.client_event_id ??
1261     `confirm-${proposal.proposal_id ?? proposal.proposal_hash ?? 'anon'}`;
1262 
1263   // T-IDEM-11: double submit → original job_id, no second bind/launch
1264   const idemKey = opts.project_path
1265     ? `${path.resolve(opts.project_path)}::${client_event_id}`
1266     : `mem::${client_event_id}`;
1267   if (_idempotenceCache.has(idemKey)) {
1268     const prior = _idempotenceCache.get(idemKey);
1269     return {
1270       ...prior,
1271       ok: true,
1272       idempotent: true,
1273       already_confirmed: true,
1274       skip_write: true,
1275       second_bind: false,
1276       second_launch: false,
1277       processes_launched: 0,
1278       message: `Commission already confirmed (client_event_id=${client_event_id}); original job_id returned, no second bind or launch.`,
1279     };
1280   }
1281 
1282   const at = opts.at ?? todayIso();
1283   const job_id =
1284     opts.job_id ??
1285     `ecgberht-job-${String(proposal.skill).toLowerCase()}-${proposal.proposal_hash.slice(0, 10)}`;
1286   const commissioned_as = `${proposal.skill}:${job_id}`;
1287 
1288   let roadmap = opts.roadmap ?? null;
1289   let roadmap_event = null;
1290   let projection = null;
1291   let strip = opts.strip ?? null;
1292   let strip_appended = false;
1293   let strip_instrument = null;
1294   let durable = false;
1295   let confirm_journal = false;
1296   let sot_written = false;
1297 
1298   if (opts.project_path) {
1299     // Wave 7 confirm journal (spine path)
1300     const journaled = confirmCommissionJournaled({
1301       project_path: opts.project_path,
1302       proposal: { ...proposal, requires_confirm: true },
1303       roadmap,
1304       strip,
1305       who: who.claimed,
1306       at,
1307       job_id,
1308       client_event_id,
1309       project_id: opts.project_id ?? null,
1310       home: opts.home,
1311     });
1312     if (!journaled.ok && !journaled.killed) {
1313       return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
1314         error: journaled.error ?? 'confirm-journal-failed',
1315         message: journaled.message,
1316         detail: journaled,
1317       });
1318     }
1319     roadmap = journaled.roadmap ?? roadmap;
1320     roadmap_event = journaled.roadmap_event ?? null;
1321     projection = journaled.projection ?? null;
1322     strip = journaled.strip ?? strip;
1323     strip_appended = journaled.strip_appended === true;
1324     strip_instrument = journaled.strip_instrument ?? null;
1325     durable = true;
1326     confirm_journal = true;
1327     sot_written = journaled.ok === true && journaled.killed !== true;
1328   } else {
1329     // In-memory bind for dry-run / fixtures
1330     const bindEvent = {
1331       kind: 'commission_bind',
1332       step_id: proposal.step_id,
1333       commissioned_as,
1334       at,
1335       client_event_id,
1336       proposal_hash: expectedHash,
1337     };
1338     if (roadmap) {
1339       const bound = appendRoadmapEvent(roadmap, bindEvent, { at });
1340       if (!bound.ok) {
1341         return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
1342           error: bound.error ?? 'bind-failed',
1343           message: bound.message,
1344           detail: bound,
1345         });
1346       }
1347       roadmap = bound.roadmap;
1348       roadmap_event = bound.event;
1349       projection = bound.projection;
1350     }
1351     if (strip) {
1352       strip_instrument = {
1353         _kind: 'instrument',
1354         kind: 'commission_confirm',
1355         as_of: at,
1356         job_id,
1357         commission_id: proposal.commission?.commission_id ?? null,
1358         step_id: proposal.step_id,
1359         skill: proposal.skill,
1360         depth_cell: proposal.depth_cell ?? null,
1361         state: 'queued',
1362         who: who.claimed,
1363         client_event_id,
1364         proposal_hash: expectedHash,
1365       };
1366       const appended = appendStripInstrument(strip, strip_instrument, {
1367         apply_to_projection: false,
1368       });
1369       if (!appended.ok) {
1370         return commissionFailure(COMMISSION_CODE.STATE_UNKNOWN, {
1371           error: 'strip-append-failed',
1372           message: appended.message,
1373         });
1374       }
1375       strip = appended.strip;
1376       strip_appended = true;
1377     }
1378   }
1379 
1380   const job = {
1381     schema: JOB_SCHEMA_ID,
1382     job_id,
1383     commission_id: proposal.commission?.commission_id ?? null,
1384     proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id ?? null,
1385     proposal_hash: expectedHash,
1386     step_id: proposal.step_id,
1387     skill: proposal.skill,
1388     depth_cell: proposal.depth_cell ?? null,
1389     seat: proposal.seat ?? proposal.seats ?? null,
1390     estimate: proposal.estimate ?? null,
1391     confirmed_by: who,
1392     confirmed: true,
1393     runner: ANCHOR_JOB_COMPOSE.runner,
1394     compose: ANCHOR_JOB_COMPOSE,
1395     spawn: proposal.commission ?? null,
1396     state: 'queued',
1397     commissioned_as,
1398     lifecycle_events: [
1399       {
1400         seq: 1,
1401         from: null,
1402         to: 'queued',
1403         at,
1404         observed: 'commission_confirm',
1405         who: who.claimed,
1406       },
1407     ],
1408   };
1409 
1410   // Dossier: confirmation recorded; launch identity filled by executor
1411   let dossier = null;
1412   if (opts.project_path) {
1413     const up = upsertDossier(opts.project_path, {
1414       job_id,
1415       commissioned_as,
1416       proposal: {
1417         proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id,
1418         proposal_hash: expectedHash,
1419         skill: proposal.skill,
1420         step_id: proposal.step_id,
1421         depth_cell: proposal.depth_cell,
1422         seat: proposal.seat,
1423         estimate: proposal.estimate,
1424       },
1425       confirmation: {
1426         who,
1427         at,
1428         client_event_id,
1429         proposal_hash: expectedHash,
1430         confirmed: true,
1431       },
1432     });
1433     if (up.ok) dossier = up.dossier;
1434   } else {
1435     dossier = {
1436       ...emptyDossier(job_id, commissioned_as),
1437       proposal: {
1438         proposal_id: proposal.proposal_id,
1439         proposal_hash: expectedHash,
1440         skill: proposal.skill,
1441         step_id: proposal.step_id,
1442       },
1443       confirmation: {
1444         who,
1445         at,
1446         client_event_id,
1447         proposal_hash: expectedHash,
1448         confirmed: true,
1449       },
1450     };
1451   }
1452 
1453   // Executor seam — ONLY path to launch
1454   let executor_result = null;
1455   let launched = false;
1456   let confirmed_and_unlaunched = false;
1457   let no_executor_host = false;
1458   let processes_launched = 0;
1459   let pid = null;
1460   let proc_create_time = null;
1461 
1462   if (opts.skip_executor !== true) {
1463     executor_result = executeCommission(
1464       {
1465         ...job,
1466         confirmed: true,
1467         confirmation: dossier?.confirmation ?? { confirmed: true, who },
1468         dossier,
1469       },
1470       {
1471         confirmed: true,
1472         who,
1473         project_path: opts.project_path ?? null,
1474         // Launch-seam revalidation is opt-in via executor_ctx.authCtx (or a
1475         // direct executeCommission call). Do NOT auto-forward confirm authCtx:
1476         // confirm already authorized; Wave 19 launch refusals are proven on
1477         // the executeCommission path (auth outcome sweep), and auto-forward
1478         // would re-hit authorize('launch') on every confirm+launch.
1479         ...(opts.executor_ctx ?? {}),
1480       },
1481     );
1482 
1483     if (
1484       executor_result &&
1485       executor_result.code === COMMISSION_CODE.NO_EXECUTOR_HOST
1486     ) {
1487       no_executor_host = true;
1488       confirmed_and_unlaunched = true;
1489       launched = false;
1490       processes_launched = 0;
1491       // Preserve confirmed state by name on dossier
1492       if (opts.project_path && dossier) {
1493         upsertDossier(opts.project_path, {
1494           job_id,
1495           commissioned_as,
1496           confirmation: {
1497             ...(dossier.confirmation ?? {}),
1498             confirmed: true,
1499             launch_state: 'confirmed-and-unlaunched',
1500             no_executor_host: true,
1501           },
1502           launch: {
1503             state: 'confirmed-and-unlaunched',
1504             no_executor_host: true,
1505             pid: null,
1506             proc_create_time: null,
1507             at,
1508           },
1509         });
1510       } else if (dossier) {
1511         dossier.launch = {
1512           state: 'confirmed-and-unlaunched',
1513           no_executor_host: true,
1514           pid: null,
1515           proc_create_time: null,
1516           at,
1517         };
1518         dossier.confirmation = {
1519           ...(dossier.confirmation ?? {}),
1520           launch_state: 'confirmed-and-unlaunched',
1521           no_executor_host: true,
1522         };
1523       }
1524     } else if (executor_result && executor_result.ok !== false) {
1525       launched = executor_result.launched !== false;
1526       processes_launched = launched ? 1 : 0;
1527       pid = executor_result.pid ?? null;
1528       proc_create_time = executor_result.proc_create_time ?? null;
1529       if (launched && (pid != null || proc_create_time != null)) {
1530         if (opts.project_path) {
1531           recordLaunchOnDossier(opts.project_path, {
1532             job_id,
1533             commissioned_as,
1534             pid,
1535             proc_create_time,
1536             intent: executor_result.intent ?? { kind: 'launch_intent', at },
1537             at,
1538           });
1539         } else if (dossier) {
1540           dossier.launch = {
1541             pid,
1542             proc_create_time,
1543             at,
1544             intent: executor_result.intent ?? null,
1545           };
1546         }
1547       }
1548     }
1549   }
1550 
1551   const success = {
1552     ok: true,
1553     spelling: SPELLING,
1554     job,
1555     job_id,
1556     commissioned_as,
1557     who,
1558     proposal_hash: expectedHash,
1559     client_event_id,
1560     roadmap,
1561     roadmap_event,
1562     projection,
1563     strip,
1564     strip_appended,
1565     strip_instrument,
1566     dossier,
1567     durable,
1568     confirm_journal,
1569     sot_written,
1570     bind_appended: true,
1571     launched,
1572     processes_launched,
1573     pid,
1574     proc_create_time,
1575     confirmed_and_unlaunched,
1576     no_executor_host,
1577     silently_queued: false,
1578     executor_result,
1579     single_writer: ROADMAP_SINGLE_WRITER,
1580     compose: ANCHOR_JOB_COMPOSE,
1581     runner: ANCHOR_JOB_COMPOSE.runner,
1582     idempotent: false,
1583     already_confirmed: false,
1584     message: no_executor_host
1585       ? COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.NO_EXECUTOR_HOST]
1586       : `Commission confirmed by ${who.claimed}: ${commissioned_as} bound to step '${proposal.step_id}'${launched ? ' and launched' : ' (queued)'}.`,
1587   };
1588 
1589   // When no-executor-host, surface the named code while keeping ok-ish confirmed state
1590   if (no_executor_host) {
1591     const named = {
1592       ...success,
1593       // Confirmed succeeded; launch refused by name — dual status
1594       ok: true,
1595       code: COMMISSION_CODE.NO_EXECUTOR_HOST,
1596       status: COMMISSION_CODE.NO_EXECUTOR_HOST,
1597       status_code: COMMISSION_CODE.NO_EXECUTOR_HOST,
1598       text: COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.NO_EXECUTOR_HOST],
1599       user_text: COMMISSION_TEXT[COMMISSION_CODE.NO_EXECUTOR_HOST],
1600       confirmed: true,
1601       launched: false,
1602     };
1603     _idempotenceCache.set(idemKey, named);
1604     return named;
1605   }
1606 
1607   _idempotenceCache.set(idemKey, success);
1608   return success;
1609 }
1610 
1611 /**
1612  * Recompute proposal_hash from a proposal object (post-render mutation detect).
1613  * @param {object} proposal
1614  * @returns {string}
1615  */
1616 export function recomputeProposalHash(proposal) {
1617   const body = proposalHashBody({
1618     skill: proposal.skill,
1619     seat: proposal.seat ?? proposal.seats ?? {},
1620     depth_cell: proposal.depth_cell ?? proposal.depth ?? null,
1621     estimate: proposal.estimate ?? {},
1622   });
1623   return hashCommissionProposal(body);
1624 }
1625 
1626 function normalizeWho(who) {
1627   if (who == null) return null;
1628   if (typeof who === 'string' && who.trim()) {
1629     return {
1630       claimed: who.trim(),
1631       provenance: 'claimed_unauthenticated',
1632     };
1633   }
1634   if (typeof who === 'object' && who.claimed && String(who.claimed).trim()) {
1635     return {
1636       claimed: String(who.claimed).trim(),
1637       provenance: who.provenance ?? 'claimed_unauthenticated',
1638     };
1639   }
1640   return null;
1641 }

1643 /**
1644  * Build a skills table fixture with named skills commissionable (tests).
1645  * @param {string[]} skills
1646  * @param {{ nonCommissionable?: string[] }} [opts]
1647  */
1648 export function makeSkillsTableFixture(skills, opts = {}) {
1649   const rows = [];
1650   for (const skill of COMMISSION_SKILLS) {
1651     const commissionable = skills.includes(skill);
1652     rows.push({
1653       skill,
1654       executor_proven: commissionable,
1655       executor_evidence: commissionable
1656         ? { pid: 1, proc_create_time: 1.0, handback_id: `fix-${skill}` }
1657         : null,
1658       evidence_class: commissionable ? 'live-skill' : null,
1659       halt_class: commissionable ? 'EXTERNALLY-OBSERVABLE' : 'INVISIBLE',
1660       excluded_reason: commissionable ? null : 'executor_not_proven',
1661       commissionable,
1662     });
1663   }
1664   for (const skill of opts.nonCommissionable ?? []) {
1665     const existing = rows.find((r) => r.skill === skill);
1666     if (existing) {
1667       existing.commissionable = false;
1668       existing.excluded_reason = existing.excluded_reason ?? 'test_excluded';
1669     }
1670   }
1671   return {
1672     schema: 'ecgberht-commissionable-skills-v0',
1673     generated_by: 'makeSkillsTableFixture',
1674     rows,
1675     commissionable_count: rows.filter((r) => r.commissionable).length,
1676   };
1677 }
